issues.title: Missing drawer overlay backdrop
issues.description: Drawer lacks a dimming overlay, causing high-contrast background content to bleed into the top header of the drawer.
issues.evidence: The collapsible card text remains visible directly above and behind the drawer top edge.
issues.suggestion: Add a dimmed backdrop overlay behind DrawerContent.
issues.triageNote: pair-038 deliberately uses modal={false} dismissible={false} (persistent bottom sheet); vaul and Radix Dialog render no overlay in non-modal mode by design, so the un-dimmed background is the documented pattern, not a component defect. Responded to the eval agent's open question with an additive opt-in: Drawer now accepts nonModalOverlay to render a pointer-events-none scrim behind non-modal sheets (src/components/ui/drawer.tsx + non-modal demo).

issues.title: Insufficient bottom padding
issues.description: Drawer action buttons lack bottom safe area inset.
issues.evidence: Footer buttons touch close to the bottom viewport edge.
issues.suggestion: Add safe-area bottom padding to DrawerFooter.
issues.triageNote: DrawerFooter hardcoded p-4 with no safe-area support; replaced with px-4 pt-4 pb-[max(1rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] so notched devices reserve the home-indicator inset (no visual change where env()=0).

issues.title: Typographical spacing in banner
issues.description: Unintended space inside the word 'instead' in the savings callout.
issues.evidence: The green banner reads 'ins tead of $216'.
issues.triageNote: Source string in src/app/eval/pair-111/page.tsx is '$173/mo instead of $216.' with no internal space, and no word-break/hyphenation CSS exists in globals.css; the banner text cannot split mid-word — JPEG/vision misread.
